title: Flexible Greeter
story: The workshop greeter can change its words and punctuation.
goal: Write greet(name, greeting="Hello", punctuation="!") returning for example Hello, Asha!
hints: Parameters with = have default values. Callers can skip them.

def greet(name, greeting="Hello", punctuation="!"):
    return f"{greeting}, {name}{punctuation}"
socratic: What happens if the caller leaves out greeting?
How can a caller change only punctuation?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Flexible Greeter”?
solution:
def greet(name, greeting="Hello", punctuation="!"):
    return f"{greeting}, {name}{punctuation}"
alt:
def greet(name, greeting="Hello", punctuation="!"):
    return greeting + ", " + name + punctuation
